concerns.description: Build inputs, checker reports and admission
concerns.rationale: Discrete validation jobs fit ordinary processes; clocked tokens are not persisted business facts.

concerns.description: Declared rates, bounded storage and backpressure
concerns.rationale: Budget declarations can generate specialized obligations, but do not supply firing semantics.
HDL simulator defines simultaneous edge-triggered update and stall behavior; arbitrary Process ordering would change semantics.
For static rates use an SDF scheduler; ready/valid stalls make elapsed time variable even when sample order is stable.
Independent clock domains require CDC analysis/async FIFO implementation, never an unqualified process edge.

facets.meaning: An illustrative one-slot elastic stage conserves accepted samples while tolerating downstream stalls.
obligations: Prove no loss/duplication for accepted ready/valid transfers.
Changing either static rate requires balance and capacity analysis.
This sidecar is not a scheduler, synthesis constraint, or CDC proof.

realization.strategy: Export source/test/constraint identities to HDL tools; record evidence independently of application ownership.
realization.placement: Illustrative single-clock stage; FPGA/ASIC choice and clock constraints remain physical realization.
limitations: Directed RTL simulation is not exhaustive formal verification or synthesis/timing closure.
No asynchronous clock-domain crossing is implemented.
Sample tokens and registers remain external to ConceptIR.

artifacts.claim: One-slot ready/valid pipeline, verified by directed stall/replacement test.
Checks occupancy, stable stalled output, ordering and sample conservation.
Pins source and testbench; records directed simulation only.
